pages.title: Not Printable
pages.text: A $(l)Not Printable$() status means the machine can't print what you gave it, for one of two reasons:$(br)$(li)the block's $(l)material tier is above the machine's tier$() (e.g. netherite on a Tier 3 printer)$(li)the block has $(l)no FU value$() and you're in strict mode ($(l)default$()) — un-priced blocks can't be printed$(br2)Use a higher-tier machine, or set $(o)unknownBlocksPrintable=true$() to price unknowns.
